note: Set-up: stem color up, diamond. https://origami.me/pumpkin/
1: Precrease the vertical diagonal.
2: Pinch the center of the horizontal diagonal; short 6% mark.
3a: Bring the left corner to the center.
3b: Bring the right corner to the center.
4a: Bring the left edge to the center.
4b: Bring the right edge to the center.
5a: Pleat the left inner edge out.
5b: Pleat the right inner edge out.
6: Untuck the left pleat via saved CP import: flatten only its two internal creases, with the released corner above the unchanged body.
7: Open the released left triangle.
8: Fold the left corner back on its existing crease.
9a: Untuck the right pleat through the saved CP import, preserving the original body order.
9b: Open the released right triangle.
9c: Refold the right corner on its existing crease.
10: Bring the top corner down along the shoulder line.
11: Precrease the lower corner to the right edge junction.
12: Precrease the same corner to the left edge junction.
13: Collapse the prepared stem toward the right through saved CP import; the moving stem remains above the stationary right corner.
14: Lift the near packet so its two lower corners meet the top edge.
15: Lift the bottom point along the line between the two shoulder intersections.
16: Lower the near flap point to the bottom edge.
17a: Round the upper left corner onto the stem-fold junction.
17b: Repeat at the upper right corner.
18: Turn over to the finished flat pumpkin; optional standing display omitted.
